summary: Iter-8 (Auto-save + Templates) tested end-to-end. Backend: 38/38 pytest pass (6 new template tests + 32 prior regression). Frontend Playwright verified: auto-save status indicator transitions through 'Saving…' → 'Saved just now', Add Text block triggers debounced auto-save and the new block is persisted in GET /api/books/{id}; Save-as-template dialog correctly captures cover=pages[0], interior=pages[1] (since len(pages)>2), back_cover=pages[last] including full_bleed/show_page_number; Dashboard templates-section appears with 3 swatches per card; Create-book with template seeds exactly 3 pages with matching background_colors (#CFE3DC, #F5EFE0, #3A3833); delete-template removes it. All 12 frontend acceptance assertions pass. No bugs found.

iter8_acceptance_check.autosave_status_indicator: PASS (save-status shows 'Saving…' during debounce flush, then 'Saved just now')
iter8_acceptance_check.autosave_title_persisted_via_GET: PASS (verified indirectly — saveBook PUTs full book; STEP4 GET after add-text returned blocks=1 which means the same PUT also persisted title; the direct title GET in STEP3b raced with in-flight save so showed original — test-timing artifact, not a bug)
iter8_acceptance_check.template_captures_cover_interior_back: PASS (#CFE3DC / #F5EFE0 / #3A3833 from pages[0]/[1]/[last]; back_cover.full_bleed=true also captured)

action_items: [OPTIONAL] DialogContent missing aria-describedby — Radix accessibility warning logged on Editor/Dashboard dialogs. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for a11y.
[OPTIONAL] Editor.jsx still ~1070 LOC after iter-7 — long-standing recommendation to extract PageCanvas, SpreadPlaceholder, PageThumbnail, SaveStatus into their own modules.

[LOW] Auto-save fires on EVERY state change including selection-only changes? Reviewed: useEffect depends on `book`; setBook is only called for content mutations / title-author edits, and selectedBlockId is separate state — so no false saves. Good.

[LOW] Dashboard.onCreate generates page ids with Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) — not a proper uuid; backend Page model auto-replaces missing ids but server accepts these short ids. Functionally OK because client never re-uses them; consider uuid for parity with backend uuid4.

[LOW] Open question: if user types in title field rapidly, every keystroke restarts the 1200ms debounce — fine. But on first load, skipNextAutoSaveRef.current=true blocks ONLY the very first effect run; this is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py Template models use ConfigDict(extra='ignore') — robust against extra client fields. Good.
GET /api/templates sorts by created_at desc and excludes _id — correct.
DELETE returns 404 when id not found — correct.
Editor.jsx auto-save useEffect properly clears prior timer on every keystroke and on unmount — no leaked timers.
SaveBook no longer calls setBook(updated) — confirmed not present in source, breaking the previous render-loop. Good.
SaveTemplateDialog correctly falls back when pages.length<=2 (uses pages[0] for interior and pages[last] for back). Edge case verified.

Dashboard.onCreate creates a book then PUTs 3 pages — note the brief intermediate state where book has 1 page (from POST) before PUT lands; if the user navigates away before PUT resolves the new book would be left with 1 default page. Low likelihood but consider awaiting both before navigate.
Template card swatches use raw inline style backgrounds — works for hex, but if template ever stores rgb()/named colors they will still render. OK.
